agencies.how_read: One standing timetable for all 75 centres (re-issued about once a school year, not monthly). Each session is the board's 'Drop-in Program Hours' column. The last half hour of each day ('Community Support') is left out: the board lists it apart from drop-in hours. 'to' is the last school day before the winter break; the timetable itself gives no end date and no closure dates.

agencies.source: Fall 2026 EarlyON flyer (the 'Download Flyer' link under the EarlyON tab) and the public activity pages at https://app.amilia.com/store/en/mfrc/shop/programs
agencies.note: Sign up first for most programs here (free)
agencies.how_read: One flyer for all sites, the same every week from September to December. The flyer is headed 'EarlyON Registered Programs' and says registration is required for all of them; only 'Where Friends Meet' is called a drop-in. The agency's catalogue offers each one as a free 'drop-in' to register for, so they are listed with the Reserve ahead tag rather than left out. Ages are not on the flyer: they are the wording on each activity's catalogue page, and sessions with no age wording carry none. Day, time and place agree between the two sources. The catalogue has no sessions on Dec 24, so that day is marked closed rather than left to the city's hours.

agencies.agency: East Scarborough Boys and Girls Club
agencies.source: https://esbgc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/WEBSITE-November-2026-Program-Calendar-for-All-Sites-1.pdf and the Calendar Descriptions PDF beside it
agencies.how_read: Monthly calendar, one page per day, plus a descriptions PDF that gives the ages. Whether a program needs sign-up is not on the calendar; it was taken from each program's page in the club's public catalogue. Most say to just drop in. All Mornelle programs and Galloway's Gym Time and Saturday Together Time are filed as drop-in there but also show an Enroll button, so they carry the Reserve ahead tag to be safe.

Babies Morning Out at Mornelle: in the catalogue but not on the November calendar
Kids Club, parent consultations and public health Q&As (not sessions a family can come to on their own)

agencies.agency: East Scarborough Boys and Girls Club (library programs)
agencies.source: November 2026 Calendar Descriptions PDF on that page, which states each library program's run into December
agencies.how_read: Kept apart from the club's own sites because the descriptions PDF gives these three programs' dates through mid-December (Port Union Mondays to Dec 14; Highland Creek and Guildwood Wednesdays to Dec 16). It says no registration is needed. 'to' runs past the last session so the city's generic hours do not reappear after each program's stated last date.
